verdict.rationale: Evidence shows only an interactive CLI for scaffolding new projects from templates (phaser-docs-2, phaser-docs-21) and a separate visual editor/MCP agent workflow (phaser-docs-12/13/14) — nothing documents a headless build/export command or CI pipeline integration for producing a distributable game build without human interaction. Standard bundler usage (webpack/vite) is implied by the framework but never evidenced as a first-party 'build and export' CLI story.
